subject: Taxes
title: Charitable Giving and Taxes
description: A quick win: understand Charitable Giving and Taxes.

hook.text: Donate to charity, reduce your taxes. The charitable deduction lets you subtract donations from taxable income.

buildup.text: Americans donate about $500 billion to charity annually.

discovery.text: Donating appreciated stock lets you avoid capital gains tax AND take the deduction.

twist.text: Since 90% of filers take the standard deduction, they get no tax benefit from charitable giving.

climax.text: The charitable deduction subsidizes giving by the wealthy while doing nothing for most donors.

punchline.text: Donate stock, skip the gains tax. The rich donor's favorite strategy.

quiz.question: Why is donating appreciated stock especially tax-efficient?
options: You avoid capital gains tax and get a deduction
